article.title: My advice for a Paris visit
article.excerpt: This is for another friend, here are my pointers: 1. Find a very good food street/corner and take many of your meals there. I’ve used Rue Daguerre and around Rue des Arts (Left Bank) for this purpose, but there are many others.
